summary: Ocean Network (oncompute.ai) launched its Inference product on September 10, 2026 and is giving away 6 hours of H200 inference in complimentary tokens to mark the launch. Inference runs OpenAI-compatible models from Hugging Face Hub on dedicated node-operator GPUs with per-hour pricing shown before launch (H200 listed at $2.16/hr). Requires a funded wallet on Base — either an external wallet or the built-in Smart Wallet with email/social login and fiat on-ramp.
claim_steps: Open the official launch announcement and follow “Claim yours here” to https://dashboard.oncompute.ai/grant/details.
Log in using an external wallet or the Smart Wallet; the grant-details page requires an authenticated account.

Confirm that the six-hour H200 grant is available to your account and read its conditions before booking a session. Private eligibility and caps have not been tested; the public announcement states no global end date.

Then open https://dashboard.oncompute.ai/inference and select a curated/custom model, service or template. The published runtime flow uses a funded wallet on Base; do not assume the grant removes every funding requirement.
